title: One-off charges
description: Let staff add a single extra charge to a learner, such as a one-on-one bridge class, from the learner’s Payments tab.

add.title: Add a charge
add.point1: Staff enter a title, an amount and a due date, and can link it to a batch.
add.point2: An optional note is for staff only.
add.point3: A charge that is not paid yet can be cancelled.

pay.title: Learner pays online
pay.point1: The charge appears in the learner app with a Pay button.
pay.point2: It is paid through your payment gateway, like any invoice.
pay.point3: It also shows in the learner’s invoices and account summary, and can be marked paid offline.

quiet.title: No messages
quiet.point1: Adding or cancelling a charge sends the learner no email, WhatsApp or notification.
quiet.point2: No tax is added: the learner pays the amount you enter.

offNote: Switching this off hides one-off charges in the learner app and stops new ones. Charges still due stay on the learner’s Payments tab so they can be cancelled.
audit: Every charge added or cancelled is recorded in the activity log, with who did it and when.
